resolved_questions.question: Can native entity visibility bypass plugin vanish/permissions?
resolved_questions.result: No confirmed bypass. Actual ChunkMap native prefilter retains updatePlayer/broadcastToPlayer/isChunkTracked/Y-range/canSeeChunkMapUpdatePlayer gates. CraftPlayer XOR visibility rule preserved.

resolved_questions.question: Can unauthorized users mutate native/worldgen behavior with the density command?
resolved_questions.result: Command constructor sets lattice.command; execute uses testPermission; tabComplete uses testPermissionSilent.

resolved_questions.question: Are native LOS/query/pathfinder fallbacks unbounded or unchecked at player-controlled boundaries?
resolved_questions.result: No concrete attacker-to-security-impact chain confirmed. LOS returns nullable fallback, bounds per mask/distance/cache; ClassValue reflection respects LOS overrides. Pathfinding bounds volume/distance and warmup, uses fallback. JNI wrappers take server-owned arrays/counts rather than raw packet arrays. Entity/spatial query hooks retain predicates and platform hooks.

resolved_questions.question: Are all native light runtime classes dead?
resolved_questions.result: No: constructor allocation is live. Queue integration is unconnected in final applied source; no direct player capability to create/unload worlds demonstrated. JNI NewGlobalRef released only by destroy suggests lifecycle retention on administrative world cycles, but no remote exploit established.

resolved_questions.question: Are optimized collections and native Brain eligibility unsafe by construction?
resolved_questions.result: No concrete security finding. Activity registry bounds are static built-in IDs; prepared native eligibility inputs are validated when packed. Applied Brain snapshot shortcut invalidated by memory changes/behavior attempts and preserves extra-start conditions. Reentrant plugin mutation could require correctness testing but is not established hostile input.
